settings.privacy_note_body: The photo or text you choose may be sent to the OCR/AI system to create a lesson. The app does not keep the original photo by default and does not send full content to analytics. Avoid uploading highly sensitive content.
settings.ai_disclaimer_body: Analysis results are generated by AI and may not be fully accurate. Use them as a learning aid, not an official English assessment.
settings.local_data_note: Lessons are stored locally on your device. You can delete your learning data anytime from Profile.
settings.support_prompt: Send feedback or report a bug by email. The app doesn't include lesson content in the email — please describe the issue in words.
